subject: How do you get draws from the posterior distribution?

messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: How do you get draws from the posterior distribution?
parts:
Hi,

Suppose I run the following model:

fit1 <- brm(outcome ~ trt + X, data = df1)

I would like to save N draws from the posterior distribution of `trt` to an object `posterior_trt`. How can I do that?

Thanks!

Ignacio

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] How do you get draws from the posterior distribution?
parts: Check out the 'posterior_samples' and 'parnames' method.
